panels.title: Question type: Complication (N = 55)
notes: Only the Correct (green) segment of each of 37 bars is recorded; the other segments (2OP, EOP, NOP, Error, Incorrect) are thin and the image is too low-resolution to read them reliably.
Values are read from bar heights, snapped to multiples of 1/55 where labels agree; in-bar labels are mostly blurry.
Phi3-3b-Q16 and Phi3-14b-Q6 are the last two bars; the empty slots between groups are spacers.

description: Five stacked-bar panels give the percentage of answers by outcome (Correct, 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error, Incorrect) for 37 LLM configurations, split by question type: Complication, Diagnosis, Investigation, Pathophysiology and Treatment.
uncertain: The 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error and Incorrect segments of all 37 bars in all five panels. They are thin and the image is too low-resolution to measure; this is about 5 of the 6 stacked series.

The percentage labels printed inside the bars. They are blurry, so Correct values come from bar heights and are approximate (about ±1 point), and are exact only for the Pathophysiology panel, where N=3 limits the values to 0, 33.3, 66.7 and 100.
Model names were reconstructed from the garbled rotated tick labels and the group structure (GPT, Claude, Mistral, Llama, Gemini/Gemma, Phi). The empty spacer slots between groups are not bars.
